content.text: Excellent performance. Now over-limit inputs and destination-preservation semantics:

arguments.command:
cd /work/tmp && python3 -c "
with open('fib_over.txt','w') as f:
    for i in range(200001):
        f.write('2001:db8::%x/64 %d\n' % (i, i))
with open('trace_over.txt','w') as f:
    for i in range(1000001):
        f.write('2001:db8::%x\n' % (i % 65536))
" 
echo "--- 200001 FIB records:"; /work/submit/planb64 build fib_over.txt over.idx; echo "rc=$? exists=$(test -e over.idx && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "--- 1000001 trace records (valid image):"; /work/submit/planb64 lookup fib_top.idx trace_over.txt scalar > /dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- 400002-row image:"
python3 -c "
rows = ['%016x %d 64' % (2*i+1, i % 100) for i in range(400002)]
open('img_over.idx','w').write('PLANB64 1\n400002\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\n' + '\n'.join(rows[1:]) + '\n')
"
/work/submit/planb64 lookup img_over.idx trace_max.txt scalar | head -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "--- exactly 400001-row image accepted:"; /work/submit/planb64 lookup fib_top.idx trace_max.txt scalar | wc -l
echo "--- failed build leaves destination untouched:"
printf 'KEEPME' > keep.idx
/work/submit/planb64 build fib_over.txt keep.idx 2>err.txt; echo "rc=$? content=$(cat keep.idx)"; cat err.txt
/work/submit/planb64 build /nonexistent keep.idx 2>err.txt; echo "rc=$? content=$(cat keep.idx)"; cat err.txt
ls | grep -c "tmp" ; echo "stray tmp files: $(ls | grep -c 'planb64-tmp' || true)"
